title: Dispatch: 19.5.12 inventory repair cycle 2 after Sol S1-S3 (attempt 3)
description:
Second (and last narrow) repair cycle of the inventory statement-accuracy class on PR #643. Read: owning bead eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12 DESIGN and its latest note (cycle-2 method); review .7 notes (S1-S3, each with invariant, scenario, sibling analysis, closure, evidence); review .5 notes (cycle-1 findings S1-S6, for the shape of the class); the attempt-2 change log in .6 notes.
REQUIRED:
(1) Repair S1 (close_combat_instance ordered lifecycle: durable topology rebound before instance-only cleanup; timer settlement/concentration exceptions), S2 (separate the pure binding check from writeCampaignRulesBinding persistence with truthful callable identities and inputs incl. db; or one grouped entry that names both callables), S3 (ADR 0012 character continuity/custody family from characterCustody.ts / characterRegistry.ts and their CLI consumers playCharacter.ts, playClose.ts, playFork.ts: checkout single-writer refusals, append-only revisions, owner-checked sync-back/release, guarded resume, catch-up, explicit fork; grouped where justified; existing evidence characterCustody.test.ts / characterRegistry.test.ts).
(2) OMISSION CLASS, independent population: enumerate every .ts module under packages/core/src/{state,character,campaign,checkpoint,memory,rules,orchestrator,adventure,discovery} that has at least one non-test production importer (or is a tool module). For each, disposition: covered-by <revision(s)> (it appears in that entry's runtimeOwner) or not-a-deterministic-commitment with a one-line reason (pure types, rendering, model prompt text, pack loading/validation, discovery retrieval, diagnostics, etc.). Commit this as an exported MODULE_DISPOSITIONS map in the inventory module and extend the closure test: every module file in those directories with a production importer is either a runtimeOwner of some entry or in MODULE_DISPOSITIONS, and every listed path exists. This is a file-level bounded population, not a symbol census. Any module you disposition as covered must actually have its performed operations stated in that entry.
(3) ACCURACY CLASS: for EVERY entry, re-verify each claim (each guard/refusal, branch, release/persistence/atomicity statement, idempotency, input) by citing the code location (file:line) that implements it; record the citation table per entry in bd notes as development evidence. Remove or correct any claim you cannot cite. Pay particular attention to lifecycle verbs (release, detach, end, persist, atomic, idempotent, refuse) and to which callable actually performs an operation vs merely checks.
(4) Reconcile engine-capability-ownership statusReasoning. No runtime behavior, tool description, schema, or model-facing text change (resolve-check-v2 stays).
Then: verify:worktree before commit; commit on this branch (message starts with this bead id; Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>); bd notes (change log + citation tables + module disposition summary); close this bead. Do not push or open PRs; never modify eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12.
